publication_scope: Historical public-safe job catalog recovered from employer-authored Gmail copy and recruiting records
display_rules: Display archived status prominently on every role
Do not use Apply now or claim active hiring
Title-only entries must say full description not recovered
Do not invent responsibilities, compensation, hours, eligibility, dates or application routes
Historical title variants sharing a job ID are one role
Old percentage fields are literal historical listing metadata, not current equity offers
No applicant names, resumes, email addresses, private phone numbers, inbox links or private correspondence belong in the public site
This catalog contains only sourced terms; null means not verified

roles.title: AI Product Management and Research Internship
roles.description: Explore artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, learn product-development skills, and develop and execute go-to-market strategies for AI products and offerings. The source describes working closely with product and research teams and learning about services including ChatGPT, Jasper AI, DALL-E 2, MID Journey and Stable Diffusion.
responsibilities: Develop go-to-market strategies for AI products and offerings
Collaborate with product and research teams to identify new product opportunities
Analyze market trends and customer needs
Assist with fundraising efforts and financial modeling
Contribute to research and development of new AI products and technologies
Research AI services including ChatGPT, Jasper AI, DALL-E 2, MID Journey and Stable Diffusion
requirements: Strong strategic and analytical skills
Interest in AI and emerging technologies
Excellent communication skills
No prior experience necessary
Applicants from all majors and backgrounds welcome
historical_title_variants: AI Product Development and Research Internship
roles.publication_note: Historical reference only. No current hiring or offer terms are implied.

roles.title: Business Analyst Internship Opportunity - Summer 2009
roles.description: IndustryNext is a technology and design firm delivering innovative products and services to clients and consumers using emerging technologies. This Summer 2009 internship focuses on market analysis, business development and advertising for digital media products.
responsibilities: Evaluate and interpret market trends to identify new opportunities, prospective companies and associated competition.
Track media effectiveness and help develop creative models to determine new projects.
Prospect for new clients using different online and offline techniques.
Develop cohesive business strategies across IndustryNext, Incognito Digital, and Unknown Vector.
Assist with creating advertising campaigns for uvLayer.com (Social Media website).
requirements: Currently pursuing a degree in economics, marketing, advertising, media development or other related field.
Eager to learn about new technologies and platforms.
Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Strong communication skills; both verbal and written.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
Exceptional analytical and problem solving skills and a strong attention to detail.
Qualified candidates must work well in a team-oriented environment and have a passion for furthering their knowledge of the digital media industry.
